verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows https://fly.io/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec exists. Fly's docs also describe a REST API for provisioning and managing Apps, Machines, and Volumes, which such a spec would plausibly describe. Missing for 10: first-party documentation pointing users to the spec and stating which APIs it covers (e.g. confirmation that it describes the Machines REST API), and independent or community corroboration of its completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://fly.io/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.
